purpose: Teach: 共鳴/下院/壊滅/縄文/半減/弾道/受益/書簡

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、音波の共鳴現象を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing a paper on acoustic resonance phenomena, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm curiosity, gentle confirmation-seeking. Open face. Pause before his name — giving him space to settle in. Teacher-like attentiveness without distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、米国下院の動向を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was working on a paper about that.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest agreement. Slight hesitation — he's listening more than presenting. Small nod embedded in the words. Respectful of the question's genuine interest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦災で壊滅した街の再建を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were researching urban reconstruction after war damage for your paper, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pacing. Slight inflection lift at the end — inviting confirmation but not pushiness. There's care underneath the academic frame.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、縄文時代の食文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, that's what I was studying.
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost apologetic in its gentleness. He's tracking what she's saying, not defensive. A beat of quiet sincerity before the answer comes.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地震被害が半減した地域を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You were examining a region where earthquake damage was significantly reduced, yes?
lines.style: Steady, engaged focus. The phrase lands clearly without weight. She's present to what he might say next. Professional warmth, no testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、弾道ミサイルの脅威を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered that in my research.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. The words come without strain. He's following her lead, trusting the direction of the conversation. Small, genuine presence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、低所得層への受益政策を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with benefit policies for low-income populations, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, careful phrasing. There's thoughtfulness in how she frames it — respect for the subject matter. A teacher's exact recall, offered not as a test but as witness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、歴史人物の書簡集を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on a collection of historical letters for my research.
lines.style: Quiet closure. The words have a small, final quality — he's settled into the exchange. Sincere without performativity. A gentle exhale at the end.
